scope: Read-only file integrity, saved-array projections, metadata and design intake; no fresh detector/segmentation/video-decode/pytest/Windows run.

delivery_helper.note: Hash equality validates recorded evidence identity, not S11/O2/field acceptance.

native_inventory.role: interpreter cache; hash inventoried only; excluded from evidence copies/archive

method: Independent direct column-neighbor enumeration for G1; original oriented-face enumeration for H0; stored label/distance, crop/mask and count consistency for every NPZ. Graph solver correctness was not rerun.

native_archive.boundary: Local ignored archive only; no remote/off-machine backup; upstream videos/support inputs are not included.

intake_check_script_source:
"""One-time read-only intake check; writes only a fresh receipt beside this script."""
import ast
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
from zipfile import ZipFile

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/Users/sunjaekim/Developer/oil_level_tracker')
TMP = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
NATIVE = ROOT / 'sample/output/s11-design-audit-cc17924-20261009-001'
PACKAGE = Path('/tmp/codex-remote-attachments/01a12184-4e34-75a2-a5b7-71c8ddbf1a7f/a0faba80-28d0-435e-af7f-bf9a9f0df05b/1-S11-detector-handoff-cc17924-2026-10-09.zip')
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text())
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
assert head == 'cc179244c89ea59bd097fa165ea493942629e23e'
with ZipFile(PACKAGE) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None
    entries = {n: {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(z.read(n)).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(z.read(n))} for n in z.namelist()}
    for line in z.read('SHA256SUMS.txt').decode().splitlines():
        expected, name = line.split(maxsplit=1)
        assert entries[name]['sha256'] == expected
    for name, meta in entries.items():
        assert sha(TMP/name) == meta['sha256']

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('delivery_verifier', TMP/'verify_local_evidence.py')
helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
summary = read(TMP/'S11-execution-summary-cc17924-2026-10-09.json')
helper_result = helper.verify(ROOT, summary)
assert helper_result['state'] == 'RECORDED_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_MATCHES'

inventory = []
for p in sorted(NATIVE.rglob('*')):
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    item = {'path': str(p.relative_to(NATIVE)), 'sha256': sha(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size}
    if p.suffix == '.json':
        read(p)
    elif p.suffix == '.py':
        ast.parse(p.read_text(), filename=str(p))
    elif p.suffix == '.png':
        with Image.open(p) as im:
            im.verify()
    elif p.suffix == '.npz':
        with np.load(p, allow_pickle=False) as a:
            assert set(a.files) == {'labels', 'crop', 'visible', 'seeds_a', 'seeds_b', 'distance_a', 'distance_b'}
            for key in a.files:
                assert a[key].dtype.kind in 'buif' and np.isfinite(a[key]).all()
            l, v = a['labels'], a['visible']
            assert l.shape == v.shape == (104, 104) and v.dtype == np.bool_
            assert a['crop'].shape == (104, 104, 3) and a['crop'].dtype == np.uint8
            expected = np.zeros(l.shape, dtype=np.uint8)
            if len(a['seeds_a']) and len(a['seeds_b']):
                expected[v & (a['distance_a'] < a['distance_b'])] = 1
                expected[v & (a['distance_b'] < a['distance_a'])] = 2
            assert np.array_equal(l, expected)
    elif p.suffix in ('.txt', '.log'):
        p.read_text()
    elif p.suffix == '.pyc':
        item['role'] = 'interpreter cache; hash inventoried only; excluded from evidence copies/archive'
    else:
        raise AssertionError(p)
    inventory.append(item)

old = read(ROOT/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-fixed-center-readout.json')
old_pins = {**old['preflight']['inputs'], **old['preflight']['source_pins'], **old['local_artifacts'],
            **{str(Path('docs/50-diagnostics/s11')/k): v['sha256'] for k,v in old['portable_figures'].items()}}
for name, expected in old_pins.items():
    assert sha(ROOT/name) == expected, name
ablation_pre = read(NATIVE/'center-projection-ablation-preflight.json')
for name, expected in ablation_pre['inputs'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT/name) == expected, name
for name, meta in read(NATIVE/'closeout.json')['artifacts'].items():
    assert sha(NATIVE/name) == meta['sha256']

trial = read(NATIVE/'partition-trial/readout.json')
g1 = {p['summary']['plan']: p for p in read(NATIVE/'center-projection-ablation.json')['results']}
stats = []
all_frames = set()
row_count = 0
for plan in trial['results']:
    name, rows = plan['plan'], plan['rows']
    other = g1[name]['rows']
    h0_n = 0
    g1_n = 0
    run = 0
    longest = 0
    for i, (r, g) in enumerate(zip(rows, other, strict=True)):
        assert r['frame'] == g['frame'] and r['initialized'] == g['initialized'] == (i == 0)
        f = r['frame']
        all_frames.add(f)
        with np.load(NATIVE/'partition-trial'/f'{name}-f{f}.npz', allow_pickle=False) as a:
            l, v = a['labels'], a['visible']
            assert r['visible_pixels'] == int(v.sum())
            assert r['classified_pixels'] == int(np.count_nonzero(l))
            assert r['seed_a'] == len(a['seeds_a']) and r['seed_b'] == len(a['seeds_b'])
            with np.load(ROOT/'sample/output/s11-reference-current-perimeters-20261009-001'/f'f{f}-support.npz', allow_pickle=False) as original:
                assert np.array_equal(a['crop'], original['crop']) and np.array_equal(v, original['visible'])
                candidates = []
                for face, (xy, n, status) in enumerate(zip(original['owner_pixel_xy'], original['outward_normal_xy'], original['status'], strict=True)):
                    if xy[0] != 595 or n[0] != 0 or status > 1:
                        continue
                    y = float(xy[1] + n[1]/2)
                    upper = int(np.floor(y))-798
                    if 0 <= upper < l.shape[0]-1 and (l[upper,52], l[upper+1,52]) == (1,2):
                        candidates.append({'face_id': face, 'source_y': y})
                candidates.sort(key=lambda c: (c['source_y'], c['face_id']))
                assert candidates == r['center_candidates']
            direct = (np.flatnonzero((l[:-1,52] == 1) & (l[1:,52] == 2) & v[:-1,52] & v[1:,52])+798.5).tolist()
        assert direct == g['r1_current_partition_candidates']
        assert [c['source_y'] for c in candidates] == g['r0_legacy_support_candidates']
        assert r['provisional_y'] == (candidates[0]['source_y'] if len(candidates) == 1 else None)
        assert g['r1_provisional_y'] == (direct[0] if len(direct) == 1 else None)
        assert r['physical_decision'] == g['physical_decision'] == 'NOT_EVALUATED'
        if i:
            h0_n += r['provisional_y'] is not None
            g1_n += g['r1_provisional_y'] is not None
            run = run+1 if g['r1_provisional_y'] is not None else 0
            longest = max(longest, run)
        row_count += 1
    expected_h0 = next(p for p in summary['experiments']['H0']['results'] if p['plan'] == name)
    expected_g1 = next(p for p in summary['experiments']['G1']['results'] if p['plan'] == name)
    assert (h0_n, g1_n, longest) == (expected_h0['unique_appearance_proposals'], expected_g1['unique_appearance_proposals'], expected_g1['longest_unique_native_frame_run'])
    assert len(rows)-1 == expected_h0['continuation_frames'] == expected_g1['continuation_frames']
    stats.append({'plan': name, 'continuation_queries': len(rows)-1, 'h0_unique': h0_n, 'g1_unique': g1_n, 'g1_longest_continuation_native_frame_run': longest})

visual = read(NATIVE/'visual-review.json')
for name, expected in visual['generated_sheets'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT/name) == expected
media_pins = {}
for r in visual['new_decode_records']:
    assert r['frame'] == r['returned_frame']
    for suffix, key in [('.mp4','video_sha256'), ('.oilrecipe','recipe_sha256')]:
        name = f'sample/{r["sample"]}{suffix}'
        media_pins[name] = r[key]
for name, expected in media_pins.items():
    assert sha(ROOT/name) == expected, name

result = {
    'schema': 's11-cc17924-handoff-intake-v1', 'date': '2026-10-10', 'base_head': head,
    'scope': 'Read-only file integrity, saved-array projections, metadata and design intake; no fresh detector/segmentation/video-decode/pytest/Windows run.',
    'package': {'sha256': sha(PACKAGE), 'entries': entries, 'all_five_declared_checksums_match': True},
    'delivery_helper': helper_result,
    'native_inventory': inventory, 'native_total_files': len(inventory), 'native_total_bytes': sum(i['bytes'] for i in inventory),
    'native_evidence_files_excluding_cache': sum(not i['path'].endswith('.pyc') for i in inventory),
    'formats': dict(Counter(Path(i['path']).suffix for i in inventory)),
    'prior_checkpoint_pins_matched': len(old_pins), 'production_python_pins_matched': len(old['preflight']['source_pins']),
    'ablation_input_pins_matched': len(ablation_pre['inputs']), 'media_recipe_pins_matched': len(media_pins),
    'saved_projection_checks': {'h0': row_count, 'g1': row_count, 'unique_rasters': len(all_frames), 'continuation_queries': sum(s['continuation_queries'] for s in stats), 'results': stats},
    'visually_inspected_sheets': [i['path'] for i in inventory if i['path'].endswith('.png')],
    'historical_not_rerun': {'focused_pytest': '84 passed in 9.06s', 'constructed_probe_groups': 9, 'small_graph_oracle_cases': 32, 'delivery_helper_controls': 6, 'decoded_frames': 18},
    'physical_efficacy': 'NOT_EVALUATED', 'field_disposition_change': False,
    'method': 'Independent direct column-neighbor enumeration for G1; original oriented-face enumeration for H0; stored label/distance, crop/mask and count consistency for every NPZ. Graph solver correctness was not rerun.',
    'intake_check_script_sha256': sha(Path(__file__))
}
(TMP/'intake-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('native_inventory','package')}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
counts_note: 381 helper matches, 415 prior pins, 200 ablation pins and 8 media/Recipe pins overlap; do not sum them as unique evidence.
